findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: join_radar_waitlist, update_email_preferences, list_notifications, mark_notifications_read, list_coach_chats, get_coach_chat, list_headshots, update_tech_stack, list_conversations, get_conversation, start_conversation, send_message, mark_message_read, list_my_conversations, get_my_conversation, reply_to_message, mark_my_message_read · Private data: generate_application_documents, skip_job, join_radar_waitlist, submit_feedback, update_account, list_documents, get_document, update_document, delete_document, update_company_tech_stack · Public sink: submit_feedback, update_email_preferences, update_account, create_company_job, post_job_public, start_conversation, send_message, reply_to_message · Destructive: get_correct_country_name, remove_saved_job, delete_experience, delete_education, delete_document, delete_saved_answer, remove_company_perk, delete_company_job, delete_conversation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: join_radar_waitlist, update_email_preferences, list_notifications, mark_notifications_read, list_coach_chats, get_coach_chat, list_headshots, update_tech_stack, list_conversations, get_conversation, start_conversation, send_message, mark_message_read, list_my_conversations, get_my_conversation, reply_to_message, mark_my_message_read · Private data: generate_application_documents, skip_job, join_radar_waitlist, submit_feedback, update_account, list_documents, get_document, update_document, delete_document, update_company_tech_stack · Public sink: submit_feedback, update_email_preferences, update_account, create_company_job, post_job_public, start_conversation, send_message, reply_to_message · Destructive: get_correct_country_name, remove_saved_job, delete_experience, delete_education, delete_document, delete_saved_answer, remove_company_perk, delete_company_job, delete_conversation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
